ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) base with a high frequency of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters; estimated 80:20 distribution favoring low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are distributed as discrete, circular, and semi-circular blobs across the lateral spans of both lobes, transitioning to a solid low-intensity zone near the central median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire superior margin, characterized by low-amplitude pixel peaks and valleys (micro-notching).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave superior trajectory sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips; distal tips exhibit a sharp posterior curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of circular white-on-black pixel rings (rosettes) distributed across the mid and distal regions of both lobes, ranging in diameter from 10 to 40 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several fine, high-intensity linear marks; a prominent diagonal abrasion is visible on the inner-left lobe, crossing the low-intensity substrate.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive depigmentation scarring in circular patterns likely resulting from parasitic colonization; visible linear rake marks on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'starfield' pattern created by the uniform distribution of high-contrast circular spots against a dark ventral background.
